Class PlayerJSON

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.ActionJSON.PlayerJSON
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerJSON extends Object implements Serializable
This class represents the players' data in JSON format. The class is designed to be serialized and deserialized using Jackson annotations

      public static PlayerJSON fromPlayer(Player player, boolean withShip)
      PlayerJSON builder that creates the data that needs to be sent to the client. If the withShip is true the player ship will be added, otherwise the PlayerJSON will include only the player information.
